articles.abstract_en: We show that subjective assessments of employee "potential" contribute to gender gaps in promotion and pay. Using data on 29,809 management-track employees from a large retail chain, we find that women receive substantially lower potential ratings despite receiving higher performance ratings. Differences in potential ratings account for approximately half of the gender promotion gap. Women's lower potential ratings do not reflect accurate forecasts of future performance: Women subsequently outperform male colleagues, both on average and on the margin of promotion. We highlight two mechanisms driving the gender potential gap: strategic retention and stereotyping.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，对员工“潜力”的主观评估会导致晋升和薪酬方面的性别差距。使用大型零售连锁店 29,809 管理层员工的数据，我们发现，尽管女性的绩效评级较高，但其潜在评级却明显较低。潜在评级的差异约占性别晋升差距的一半。女性较低的潜在评级并不能反映对未来绩效的准确预测：女性随后在平均表现和晋升幅度上都优于男性同事。我们强调二驱动性别潜在差距的机制：战略保留和刻板印象。

articles.title_en: Evaluating the Impact of Urban Transit Infrastructure: Evidence from Bogotá's TransMilenio
articles.title_cn: 评估城市交通基础设施的影响：来自波哥大 TransMilenio 的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the effects of improving public transit infrastructure on city structure and welfare. It develops a quantitative urban model with multiple worker groups and transit modes, and derives a special case yielding sufficient statistics for aggregate welfare in a broad class of models. The paper estimates reduced-form elasticities to implement the approach using data spanning construction of the world's largest Bus Rapid Transit system in Bogotá, Colombia. This class of models explains observed adjustments in economic activity. Standard value-of-time calculations capture only 52 percent of welfare gains. Accounting for reallocation and general equilibrium effects, distributional impacts are modest.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了改善公共交通基础设施对城市结构和福利的影响。它开发了一个具有多个工人群体和交通方式的定量城市模型，并得出了一个特例，为广泛的模型中的总福利提供了足够的统计数据。该论文利用哥伦比亚波哥大世界上最大的快速公交系统建设的数据，估计了实施该方法的简化形式弹性。此类模型解释了观察到的经济活动调整。标准时间价值计算仅捕获52%的福利收益。考虑到重新分配和一般均衡效应，分配影响不大。

articles.title_en: Financial Frictions: Micro versus Macro Volatility
articles.title_cn: 金融摩擦：微观波动与宏观波动
articles.abstract_en: We argue that consumer credit spreads matter for household choices and that time-varying spreads have important distributional consequences. Studying Danish household data, we show that consumer credit spreads have heterogeneous impact on asset dynamics and consumption choices across the wealth distribution and that time-varying spreads induce a countercyclical marginal propensity to consume. We study a HANK model where banks provide consumer credit and corporate loans. Through countercyclical credit spreads, frictional finance amplifies aggregate shocks and induces consumption inequality. Economies with less leveraged banks experience reduced aggregate volatility but may face higher volatility and lower welfare at the household level.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们认为，消费者信贷利差对家庭选择很重要，并且随时间变化的利差具有重要的分配后果。通过研究丹麦家庭数据，我们发现消费信贷利差对财富分配中的资产动态和消费选择具有异质性影响，并且随时间变化的利差会引发反周期边际消费倾向。我们研究了HANK模型，其中银行提供消费信贷和企业贷款。通过反周期信用利差，摩擦金融放大了总体冲击并导致消费不平等。银行杠杆率较低的经济体总体波动性降低，但家庭层面可能面临更高的波动性和更低的福利。

articles.title_en: Raising the Stakes: Physician Facility Investments and Provider Agency
articles.title_cn: 提高赌注：医师设施投资和提供商代理
articles.abstract_en: Principal-agent problems often extend beyond what can be directly addressed through conventional incentive arrangements. We examine a context where physicians are likely under-incentivized to minimize total medical costs until their private financial interests align with those of patients. Leveraging novel data on physician ownership of ambulatory surgery centers—that is, same-day facilities—we show that these equity holdings cause a substitution away from higher cost, rival settings that lowers Medicare spending by 10–40 percent per physician. We find no clear evidence of perverse behavior following these investments. Instead, our findings demonstrate how entrepreneurial activity can indirectly limit principal-agent problems and improve efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 委托代理问题往往超出了传统激励安排所能直接解决的范围。我们研究了这样一种情况：在医生的私人经济利益与患者的经济利益一致之前，他们可能没有动力将总医疗成本降至最低。利用关于医生拥有门诊手术中心（即当日手术设施）的新数据，我们表明，这些股权持有会导致成本较高、竞争环境的替代，从而使每位医生的医疗保险支出降低10-40%。我们没有发现这些投资后出现不当行为的明确证据。相反，我们的研究结果表明创业活动如何能够间接限制委托代理问题并提高效率。

articles.title_en: Competition under Incomplete Contracts and the Design of Procurement Policies
articles.title_cn: 不完全合同下的竞争与采购政策设计
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of intensifying competition for contracts in the context of US Defense procurement. Leveraging a discontinuous regulation that mandates agencies to publicize certain contract opportunities, we document that expanding the set of bidders reduces award prices but deteriorates post-award performance in terms of cost overruns and delays. We develop and estimate an auction model with endogenous entry and stochastic execution performance, in which the buyer endogenously chooses the intensity of competition. Model estimates indicate substantial heterogeneity in performance across contractors and show that simple adjustments to the current regulation could provide significant savings in procurement spending.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国国防采购背景下合同竞争加剧的影响。利用强制各机构公布某些合同机会的不连续监管，我们发现，扩大投标人范围会降低中标价格，但会恶化中标后在成本超支和延误方面的表现。我们开发并估计了具有内生进入和随机执行绩效的拍卖模型，其中买方内生选择竞争强度。模型估计表明，承包商之间的绩效存在显着差异，并表明对现行法规的简单调整可以显着节省采购支出。

articles.title_en: Take the Goods and Run: Contracting Frictions and Market Power in Supply Chains
articles.title_cn: 拿走货物就跑：供应链中的收缩摩擦和市场力量
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the efficiency of self-enforced relational agreements, a common solution to contracting frictions, when sellers have market power and contracts cannot be externally enforced. To this end, I develop a dynamic contracting model with limited enforcement in which buyers can default on their trade credit debt and estimate it using a novel dataset from the Ecuadorian manufacturing supply chain. The key empirical finding is that bilateral trade is inefficiently low in early periods of the relationship, but converges toward efficiency over time, despite sellers' market power. Counterfactual simulations imply that both market power and enforcement contribute to inefficiencies in trade.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当卖方拥有市场力量且合同无法从外部执行时，自我执行的关系协议的效率，这是解决合同摩擦的常见方法。为此，我开发了一个执行有限的动态合同模型，在该模型中，买家可以拖欠其贸易信贷债务，并使用来自厄瓜多尔制造供应链的新颖数据集对其进行估算。关键的实证发现是，双边贸易在关系的早期阶段效率很低，但随着时间的推移，尽管卖方拥有市场力量，但会趋向于效率。反事实模拟意味着市场力量和执法都会导致贸易效率低下。

articles.title_en: Consumer Credit and the Incidence of Tariffs: Evidence from the Auto Industry
articles.title_cn: 消费者信贷与关税发生率：来自汽车行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: Captive finance subsidiaries create a channel for trade policy to affect consumer credit. Examining the impact of the Trump administration's metal tariffs on captive automobile lenders, we find that consumers received higher interest rates from captive lenders after the tariffs relative to unaffected noncaptive lenders. Further, we document a disparate impact on low-income borrowers and in areas with less lending competition. Our results suggest that tariffs may impact not only the price of goods but also the financing terms of purchases. Thus, focusing solely on directly affected product prices may underestimate tariff pass-through significantly.
articles.abstract_cn: 自保金融子公司为贸易政策影响消费者信贷创造了渠道。在研究特朗普政府的金属关税对自保汽车贷款机构的影响时，我们发现，相对于未受影响的非自保贷款机构，在征收关税后，消费者从自保贷款机构获得的利率更高。此外，我们记录了对低收入借款人和贷款竞争较少的地区的不同影响。我们的结果表明，关税不仅可能影响商品价格，还可能影响采购的融资条件。因此，仅关注直接受影响的产品价格可能会大大低估关税传导。

articles.title_en: Work from Home and the Office Real Estate Apocalypse
articles.title_cn: 在家工作和办公室房地产启示录
articles.abstract_en: We show remote work led to large drops in lease revenues, occupancy, and market rents in the commercial office sector. We revalue New York City office buildings, taking into account both the cash flow and discount rate implications of these shocks, and find a 46 percent decline in long-run value. For all US office markets combined, we find a $556.8 billion value destruction. Higher-quality buildings were buffered against these trends due to a flight to quality, while lower-quality offices are at risk of becoming a stranded asset. These valuation changes have repercussions for financial stability and local public finances.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们发现，远程工作导致商业办公领域的租赁收入、入住率和市场租金大幅下降。我们重新评估纽约市办公楼的价值，同时考虑到这些冲击对现金流和贴现率的影响，并发现长期价值下降了46%。对于所有美国写字楼市场的总和，我们发现 $556.8 十亿 价值遭到破坏。由于追求质量，较高质量的建筑受到了这些趋势的缓冲，而较低质量的办公室则面临成为搁浅资产的风险。这些估值变化会对金融稳定和地方公共财政产生影响。

articles.title_en: A Theory of Supply Function Choice and Aggregate Supply
articles.title_cn: 供给函数选择与总供给理论
articles.abstract_en: Modern theories of aggregate supply are built on the foundation that firms set prices and commit to producing whatever the market demands. We remove this strategic restriction and allow firms to choose supply functions, mappings that describe the prices charged at each quantity of production. Theoretically, we characterize firms' optimal supply function choices in general equilibrium and study the resulting implications for aggregate supply. Aggregate supply flattens under lower inflation uncertainty, higher idiosyncratic demand uncertainty, and less elastic demand. Quantitatively, our theory can rationalize the flattening of aggregate supply during the Great Moderation and steepening during the 1970s and 2020s.
articles.abstract_cn: 现代总供给理论建立在企业定价并承诺生产市场需求的基础上。我们消除了这种战略限制，并允许企业选择供给函数，即描述每种生产数量的价格的映射。从理论上讲，我们描述了一般均衡中企业的最优供给函数选择，并研究了由此产生的对总供给的影响。在通胀不确定性较低、特殊需求不确定性较高和需求弹性较小的情况下，总供给趋于平缓。从数量上讲，我们的理论可以合理解释“大稳健”期间总供给的扁平化和1970和2020期间总供给的陡峭化。

articles.title_cn: 经济学研讨会中的性别差异
articles.abstract_en: We assess whether men and women are treated differently when presenting their economics research. We collected data across thousands of seminars, job market talks, and conference presentations, leveraging human judgment and audio-processing algorithms to measure the number, tone, and type of interruptions. Within a seminar series, women are interrupted more than men. This holds when controlling for characteristics of the presenter, paper, and audience. Interruptions that are negative in tenor or tone or cut off the presenter mid-sentence increase for women presenters. We also find greater engagement of female audience members with female presenters, suggesting a potential role model effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估男性和女性在展示经济学研究时是否受到不同对待。我们收集了数千场研讨会、就业市场讲座和会议演示的数据，利用人类判断和音频处理算法来衡量中断的数量、语气和类型。在一系列研讨会中，女性比男性更容易被打断。当控制演讲者、论文和观众的特征时，这一点成立。对于女性演讲者来说，语气或语气消极的打断或打断演讲者的句子中间的情况会增加。我们还发现女性观众与女性主持人的互动程度更高，这表明潜在的榜样效应。
